 News Ken Urker’s Cause of Death Confirmed by Louisiana Coroner’s Office
 Urker shared a 1-year-old daughter with girlfriend Gypsy Rose Blanchard. Nov. 16, 2026, 10:57 AM EST / Source : TODAY Ariana Brockington
 Trending News Reporter
 Share Add TODAY to Google Authorities have confirmed that Ken Urker, the boyfriend of Gypsy Rose Blanchard , died from an accidental drug overdose. 
 Urker’s cause of death was listed as “accidental poly substance drug toxicity,” according to a statement on Nov. 16 by the the Lafourche Parish Coroner’s Office in Louisiana. 
 “The case is now complete, and no further testing is pending,” the coroner’s office said in its statement. 
 According to the CDC , a polysubstance drug overdose occurs from exposure to more than one drug. Substances can include stimulants, opioids, counterfeit pills and more.
 Urker, 34, was found dead on Oct. 1 at a home in Raceland, Louisiana , the Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office previously confirmed to NBC News.
 “We responded to a residence at 107 Double H Drive, Lot 4, in Raceland today after receiving a call at 6:15 p.m.,” the sheriff’s department said in a statement. Authorities said Urker was found “dead upon arrival” and they were investigating the case. 
 On Oct. 2, NBC News obtained a preliminary report from the sheriff’s department that said the death was “drug related.” The report also listed the incident code as “overdose.” At the time, police said they did not find any signs of foul play. 
 Urker shared a 1-year-old daughter, Aurora, with Blanchard , who served eight years in prison for her involvement in the death of her mother . 
 Following reports of his death, Blanchard told People that Urker died of an overdose. 
 “Ken was an amazing father and a man who was deeply loved,” she said. “He will forever be my soulmate and my red string, a connection that time, distance, and even death can never erase.”
 The two met when Blanchard was in prison. They got engaged in 2018 but later called it quits. Blanchard and Urker reunited a year after she was released from prison in 2023 . 
 The preliminary report said Blanchard’s half brother, Dylan Blanchard, and another man named Justin Daigle found Urker the night he died. They told police they entered Urker’s home through an unlocked bedroom window and found him unconscious on his bed. Sister-in-law Anita Blanchard was the one who called the police. 
 According to the report, authorities also discovered syringes and a spoon in the bathroom of the home, as well as “a brown powdery substance.” Another syringe and a handgun were found on the nightstand next to the bed. 
 Additionally, there was a paper towel “with what appeared to be blotches of blood” on Urker’s left arm. 
 Share Add TODAY to Google Ariana Brockington Ariana Brockington is a trending news reporter at TODAY digital. She is based in Los Angeles.
